versions.description_html:
Learn what Docker and containers actually do, how images and layers work, and why they beat virtual machines in this jargon-free, beginner guide.

Docker is the most-used tool in cloud development, and it's not even close. You've probably heard the word thrown around like it's basic knowledge everyone else already has.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • The Problem Docker Actually Solves
  • What a Container Really Is
  • Images, Dockerfiles, and the Power of Layers
  • Registries: Where Images Live and Travel
  • Containers vs Virtual Machines
  • Where People Actually Use Docker
  • The Mistakes Beginners Make
  • When You Should Not Reach for Containers

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Azure Blob Storage - Simply Explained
  • Azure Container Apps - Simply Explained
  • More Azure & Cloud episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Azure & Cloud: the most-listened episodes
